metadataRaw.title: The #1 Stretch for INSTANT Piriformis Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the #1 stretch to instantly relieve piriformis muscle pain.

If you’re unfamiliar with the piriformis muscle, it can be a literal pain in the butt.

When it becomes strained and inflamed, it may cause pain, numbness, and tingling across the buttock that travels into the hip and leg.

This is often caused by a combination of weakness and tightness that builds up in the piriformis and gluteal muscles over time.

To fix this, we’ll go over the best stretch to release tightness, along with another exercise that will help strengthen these muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.

To get the best results, try both exercises and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and start relieving piriformis pain!
